# Find the maximum date in the 'Date' column, assuming dates are in a consistent string format
# Convert to datetime for proper ordering, then get the max date as a string in the original format
df['Date_parsed'] = pd.to_datetime(df['Date'], dayfirst=True)
last_date = df['Date_parsed'].max()
# Convert back to the original string format (day month year)
answer = last_date.strftime('%d %B %Y')
